description: This file defines a Java interface named GenericRequester within the org.apache.ofbiz.service package. It specifies methods for handling results and exceptions from asynchronous service calls.

classes.name: GenericRequester
classes.description: A Java interface for asynchronous service call handling, providing methods to receive results and throwables.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Handles the reception of the result map from an asynchronous service call.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Handles the reception of a Throwable (exception) from an asynchronous service call.
